meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Online Radio Box: hides cookie notice, app promos and partner links, blurs or hides station logos, can hide directory and footer
meta.notes:
**Checked 2026-11-13**, logged out, headless Chrome on https://onlineradiobox.com/ (it redirected to the Sri Lanka list from this IP) with an iPhone UA and a desktop UA. Both received the same server-rendered page with plain class names.

- **Cookie notice**: `#alert_cookies` 1 (a bar, not one of the consent platforms the generic rule knows) (LIVE).
- **App promo**: `.about-container` 1 (the "Mobile Online Radio" block) and `.link--playmarket` / `.link--appstore` 1 each (LIVE).
- **Partner links** `.footer__sponsors` 1; **station logos** `.stations__station img` 10 and `.cooked__station__logo` 1; **local highlight** `.cooked-container` 1; **directory** `.catalog-container` 1; **footer** `footer.footer` 1 (LIVE).

Not verified: a station's player page (a fetch of one failed when the network dropped), search, the login modal (`#popup_auth`, never hidden), pages for other countries. No ad slots rendered in this capture, so the generic ad rule is unchanged.
